selection: First 50 candidate cycles fixed before gate/integrity filtering; invalid and cross-cut candidates count; no replacement by later cycles
completeness: All first 50 candidates must be confirmed complete by separate operator/campaign evidence. Settlement records alone are insufficient. Missing confirmation or unorderable official cycles keeps PRELIMINARY.
earlyAnalyses: PRELIMINARY; prohibited for decisions, tuning or early stopping based on win rate
historyContinuity: FORMAL_FIRST_50 additionally requires exactly 217 official records with valid settledAt <= edgeCut; otherwise PRELIMINARY. No inferred records, repair or candidate replacement.

primaryCI.method: cluster bootstrap by monitorCycleId with replacement
primaryCI.sampleSize: number of accepted cycles; all WIN/LOSS/TIE in each drawn cycle carried together
primaryCI.zeroBinaryReplications: exclude from percentiles and report count; null interval if none valid
primaryCI.limitation: Assumes independent cycles; degenerate with few clusters; not financial-edge guarantee

secondaryCI: naive/descriptive record-level Wilson 95%, ignores within-cycle correlation
thresholdProvenance: Derived exclusively from IS; raw Q50=0.599936477924654
OOS1Interpretation: Not independent prospective validation of the complete gate
OOS2Interpretation: First untouched prospective validation of threshold + operator
